errors.evidence: The single line in the chart uses two different marker shapes. It starts with blue circle markers for the first few epochs (1-4) and then switches to blue star markers for the remaining epochs (5-30). The description incorrectly states the line is only marked with stars and completely omits the circle markers.
The line reaches its peak value at Epoch 5, and the value is exactly 0.0010, not approximately 0.0009.
At Epoch 10, the Learn Rate is just below 0.0010 (approximately 0.0098). The value of 0.0008 is not reached until around Epoch 15.
The line ends at Epoch 30 with a Learn Rate of exactly 0.0000, as it touches the x-axis.

errors.evidence: This entire sentence describes a second line that does not exist in the figure. There is no blue solid line, no plus markers, and the described trend is fabricated.

While the underlying data points are likely at an interval of 1 epoch, the visible numerical labels on the x-axis (1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30) do not have a uniform interval of 1. The interval between the labels is mostly 5.
